messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Write a practical notice for a fictional community tool library: reserve tools online, bring identification, and report damage before returning them. Avoid a marketing tone. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: All members must reserve tools exclusively through our online portal prior to visiting the library. Walk-in requests cannot be accommodated due to limited inventory. Upon arrival, please present a valid government-issued photo identification to verify your account status before checking out any equipment. Inspect all borrowed items thoroughly for existing wear or defects immediately after use. Any newly discovered damage must be reported to staff before returning the tool. Failure to report damage may result in accountability fees. Late returns will incur standard penalties as outlined in the membership agreement.
